title: Bombay High Court refuses interim relief to Atyati in plea against Cognizant over logo trademark
description: The Bombay High Court on Tuesday declined fintech firm Atyati Technologies’ plea to restrain Cognizant from using its new 'C' logo [Atyati Technologies Private Limited v. Cognizant Technology Solutions US Corporation & Anr].Justice Sharmila Deshmukh held that Atyati has not made out a case of copyright infringement or passing off at the interim stageHence, the judge dismissed an interim application filed by Bengaluru‑based Atyati in its commercial IP suit against Cognizant Technology Solutio
